GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Signage & wayfinding

We inspect, repair and organise replacement of agreed commercial signs and wayfinding elements. We check the surface, fixings, visibility and installation access, then match the work to your existing brand and building requirements. Electrical signage and major changes are separately defined in the scope.

What we can look after

  • Entry, tenancy, directory and directional signage.
  • Sign faces, mounting hardware and localised presentation repairs.
  • Car park, loading and pedestrian wayfinding updates.

Planning the work

  1. We confirm sign content, dimensions, location and existing condition.
  2. We review materials, mounting details and safe access arrangements.
  3. We check installation, visibility and the agreed finished appearance.

Questions about this service

Can you match existing signs?+

We work from your existing artwork, brand files and site measurements. We confirm the proposed material, colour and finish before ordering or installing replacements.
